contracts_rationale: Prompt and doctrine content only: the mission defines no API, event or interface; the analysis-findings/v1 carrier it uses is unchanged.
friendly_name: Analyze readiness gate: finalize validation, WP prompts, requirement quality
purpose_context: Issues #246, #237 and #247 (epic #244): the analyze step prompt can declare a mission ready while machine-checkable task metadata is broken, WP prompt files are missing or underspecified, or requirements are untestable. This mission edits the software-dev analyze and specify prompts and cave-kitty's analyze copy so the readiness verdict reflects them.
purpose_tldr: Make /spec-kitty.analyze catch broken task metadata, weak WP prompts and low-quality requirements before implementation starts.
